name: Disney Magic
summary: Disney's original ship, with a classic Art Deco look and a cozier size than the newer ships.
kids: It's a Small World Nursery (6 months to 3 years)
Oceaneer Club and Oceaneer Lab (ages 3 to 10)

photo.alt: The Disney Magic docked at Castaway Cay, Disney's private island in the Bahamas, seen across turquoise water from the rocky shoreline

guests: about 1,750 at two per room, up to about 2,700
homePorts: Galveston, San Diego and Vancouver (Alaska) in 2027 and 2028
overview: Disney Magic is where Disney Cruise Line began, and it still has the classic ocean-liner look. It's smaller than the newer ships, which makes it easy to find your way around, and in 2027 and 2028 it covers more ground than any other ship in the fleet: the Caribbean from Galveston, Mexico from San Diego, Alaska, and the Panama Canal.
adults: Palo, adults-only Italian dining (extra cost)
Soul Cat Lounge, added in 2023
Quiet Cove adults-only pool area
Senses Spa
pools: The AquaDunk drop slide shoots you out over the side of the ship. There's also the AquaLab splash area for kids, a family pool, and the Quiet Cove pool for adults.
cons: Fewer big attractions than the newer ships
Fewer verandah rooms than the larger ships
tips: If you've always wanted the Panama Canal, the Magic's 14-night crossings (November 2027 eastbound, March 2028 westbound) are the way to do it with Disney.
Book Palo early; it's small and fills up.

highlights: Cozumel and Progreso, Mexico
Select sailings reach the Bahamas
itineraries.take: Galveston is a great drive-to option for families in Texas and the middle of the country, and the Western Caribbean ports are full of beaches, ruins and easy excursions.

highlights: A full transit of the Panama Canal
itineraries.take: A once-in-a-lifetime kind of trip. Two weeks at sea with Disney service, and a day going through the locks that you'll talk about for years.

highlights: Glaciers, wildlife and Alaska's Inside Passage
Repositioning sailings from San Diego in May and back in September
itineraries.take: Alaska on a Disney ship is a special combination: cozy, scenic sea days and some of the most dramatic scenery anywhere. A great pick for families with older kids.

highlights: Ensenada, Cabo San Lucas, Puerto Vallarta, Mazatlán and Catalina Island
itineraries.take: Short Baja trips are a perfect first cruise from the West Coast, and the longer Mexican Riviera sailings add some of Mexico's prettiest beach towns.

highlights: Disney's first visit to Fuerte Amador, Panama
itineraries.take: The eastbound crossing adds a brand-new port for Disney, which makes it a fun one for repeat cruisers who want something new.

highlights: Progreso, Cozumel and Nassau
Select 7-night Bahamian sailings stop at both Castaway Cay and Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point
Very Merrytime holiday sailings in November and December
itineraries.take: Getting both of Disney's Bahamian island stops on one trip from Texas is a real treat, and the holiday sailings bring a lot of extra sparkle.

highlights: Disney's first visit to Colón, Panama
itineraries.take: Another brand-new Disney port, and a springtime way to see the canal.

itineraries.length: 5 to 7 nights, then a 4-night coastal sailing
itineraries.route: Baja, the Mexican Riviera and the Pacific Coast
highlights: A Pacific Coast repositioning sailing to Vancouver on April 21
itineraries.take: Repositioning trips are often good value, and the Pacific Coast run is a relaxing way to see the West Coast.

name: Disney Wonder
summary: The Magic's sister ship, with an Art Nouveau look and the same classic, smaller-ship feel.
kids: It's a Small World Nursery (6 months to 3 years)
Oceaneer Club and Oceaneer Lab (ages 3 to 10)
homePorts: San Diego, plus Vancouver for Alaska in summer 2027
overview: Disney Wonder is the Magic's twin, with an Art Nouveau look and the same easy-to-navigate size. It's Disney's West Coast ship, sailing from San Diego to Baja and the Mexican Riviera, with Alaska in the summer.
adults: Palo, adults-only Italian dining (extra cost)
Quiet Cove adults-only pool, with two whirlpools, Signals bar and Cove Café
After Hours: Crown & Fin Pub, Cadillac Lounge and Azure nightclub
Senses Spa & Salon
pools: The AquaLab splash area has the Twist 'n' Spout slide, and Dory's Reef is a play area for the littlest swimmers. There are three pools, including Goofy's Pool and the adults-only Quiet Cove.
pros: The easiest way to cruise Disney from the West Coast
cons: Fewer big water attractions than the newer ships
Fewer verandah rooms than the larger ships
tips: Tiana's Place is one of the rotational restaurants; ask about the live music night.
If you're flying in, San Diego makes it easy to add a day at the beach or the zoo before you board.

highlights: Ensenada, Cabo San Lucas and Catalina Island
itineraries.take: A short Baja sailing is a fantastic first taste of Disney Cruise Line, especially for West Coast families who don't want to fly.

highlights: 7-night sailings to Alaska's glaciers and Inside Passage
itineraries.take: Alaska and the Wonder are a classic pairing: a week of glaciers, wildlife and whale-watching, with Disney's kids clubs for the days at sea.

highlights: Ensenada, Cabo San Lucas, Puerto Vallarta, Mazatlán and Catalina Island
itineraries.take: The longer Mexican Riviera trips are the sweet spot: warm water, colorful towns, and enough sea days to enjoy the ship.

highlights: A coastal repositioning sailing
itineraries.take: A short, scenic trip up the coast, and often a good value.

name: Disney Dream
summary: The first of the larger ships, which introduced the AquaDuck water coaster and virtual portholes in inside staterooms.
kids: It's a Small World Nursery (6 months to 3 years)
Oceaneer Club and Oceaneer Lab (ages 3 to 10)

photo.alt: The Disney Dream anchored off a tropical beach, with snorkelers in turquoise water in the foreground

guests: about 2,500 at two per room, up to about 4,000
homePorts: Fort Lauderdale, then Port Canaveral for summer 2027, then back to Fort Lauderdale from November 2027
overview: Disney Dream was the first of Disney's bigger ships. It introduced the AquaDuck water coaster and the virtual portholes in inside staterooms, and it specializes in short Bahamian cruises, which makes it one of the best first-cruise ships in the fleet.
adults: Palo and Remy, adults-only dining (extra cost)
The District: District Lounge, Pub 687, Pink wine and champagne bar, Skyline and Evolution
Quiet Cove pool and Satellite Falls
Senses Spa
pools: The AquaDuck water coaster loops around the top deck and out over the side of the ship. Families have Mickey's Pool and Donald's Pool, little ones have Nemo's Reef, and the Funnel Vision screen shows movies by the pool. Adults get Quiet Cove and Satellite Falls.
pros: Short sailings that are easy to fit in
Virtual portholes make inside rooms feel bigger
cons: Short trips can feel busy on the pool deck
Fewer port days on the 3-night sailings
tips: Ride the AquaDuck on embarkation day or during port days, when the line is shorter.
Look for the 6-night sailing with two days at Castaway Cay in the 2027 to 2028 season.

highlights: Nassau and Castaway Cay
itineraries.take: Short, easy, and a great value. This is the trip to book if you want to try a Disney cruise without committing a full week.

highlights: Castaway Cay and Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point
Halloween on the High Seas runs on select ships from September
itineraries.take: Port Canaveral is close to Orlando, so this is the easiest way to pair a few days at Walt Disney World with a short cruise.

highlights: One 6-night sailing with two stops at Castaway Cay
Very Merrytime holiday sailings in November and December
itineraries.take: Two days at Castaway Cay on one trip is a dream for beach lovers, and the holiday sailings are a festive way to end the year.

highlights: A longer sailing with Western Caribbean ports
itineraries.take: A nice change of pace from the Bahamas, with a little more time at sea.

name: Disney Fantasy
summary: The Dream's sister ship, with an Art Nouveau look, often sailing longer Caribbean itineraries.
kids: It's a Small World Nursery (6 months to 3 years)
Oceaneer Club and Oceaneer Lab (ages 3 to 10)
guests: about 2,500 at two per room, up to about 4,000
homePorts: Port Canaveral, then San Juan and Fort Lauderdale from December 2027
overview: Disney Fantasy is the Dream's sister ship, with the same AquaDuck and virtual portholes, but it's set up for longer trips. It's known for the Caribbean, and it had a dry dock in fall 2025 that added a new concierge tower suite and updated the spa and concierge lounge.
adults: Palo and Remy, adults-only dining (extra cost)
European-themed nightlife: La Piazza, Ooh La La, O'Gills Pub, Skyline and The Tube
Quiet Cove pool and Satellite Falls
Senses Spa
pools: The AquaDuck water coaster, the AquaLab splash area, Nemo's Reef for little ones, Mickey's and Donald's pools, and the adults-only Quiet Cove and Satellite Falls.
pros: Fresh updates from the 2025 dry dock
cons: Sea days can make the pool deck busy
tips: The 8-night Bermuda sailing visits both Castaway Cay and Lookout Cay, so it's worth watching for.
On longer trips, book a Palo or Remy night early in the cruise.

highlights: Castaway Cay
One 10-night Southern Caribbean sailing in summer 2027
Pixar Day at Sea on select 5-night sailings
itineraries.take: The Fantasy's longer trips are great for a real vacation at sea, with time to enjoy both the ship and the islands.

highlights: Halloween on the High Seas runs on select ships from September
itineraries.take: Close to Orlando and just long enough to relax. A great add-on to a Walt Disney World trip.

highlights: A 7-night Southern Caribbean sailing, then a 5-night Eastern Caribbean sailing that ends in Fort Lauderdale
itineraries.take: Starting in San Juan puts the Southern Caribbean within reach, with islands you can't easily get to on a short Florida cruise.

highlights: Disney's first-ever Bermuda cruise: 8 nights, visiting both Castaway Cay and Lookout Cay
itineraries.take: The Bermuda sailing is a true first for Disney, with pink-sand beaches plus both Bahamian island stops. A great one for repeat cruisers.

highlights: Two sailings visiting islands such as Curaçao, Bonaire, Barbados and Antigua
itineraries.take: The Southern Caribbean is hard to reach on a short Florida cruise, so these two sailings are a rare chance on a Disney ship.

name: Disney Wish
summary: The first of the newest generation of ships, with a grand fairy-tale atrium and new themed dining.
kids: It's a Small World Nursery (6 months to 3 years)
The Hideaway, a late-night space for ages 18 to 20
guests: about 2,500 at two per room, up to about 4,000
homePorts: Port Canaveral, with Europe in summer 2027 and New York in fall 2027
overview: Disney Wish was the first of Disney's newest generation of ships. It brought the AquaMouse, the first Disney attraction at sea, and a fresh mix of themed dining, and in 2027 it heads to Europe and New York for the first time.
adults: Palo Steakhouse and Enchanté, adults-only dining (extra cost)
The Rose, Nightingale's, The Bayou and Keg & Compass
An adults-only pool and bar on the upper deck
Senses Spa
pools: The AquaMouse is a water ride with show scenes and about 760 feet of tubes. Little ones get the Toy Story Splash Zone, and there are about 10 pools and water-play areas across the ship.
cons: It's a big ship, so plan where you're going
tips: Book Arendelle as early as you can if your kids love Frozen.
The fall 2027 New York season is a rare chance to cruise Disney from the Northeast.

highlights: Castaway Cay and Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point
itineraries.take: One of Disney's newest ships on its shortest trips: a perfect first Disney cruise and easy to pair with a park visit.

highlights: The Wish's first crossing to Europe, via Madeira, Gibraltar and Cartagena
itineraries.take: Lots of sea days with every Disney comfort. A dream for anyone who loves the ship itself.

itineraries.route: Mediterranean, Greek Isles, Norwegian Fjords, British Isles and Northern Europe
highlights: The Wish's first Europe season
Ports include Zadar, Trieste (for Venice), Dubrovnik, Santorini, Hellesylt and Edinburgh
itineraries.take: Europe on Disney's newest-style ship means big sightseeing days in port and a familiar, family-friendly home base at night.

highlights: Stops in Scotland, Iceland and Canada
itineraries.take: A northern crossing with real variety in its ports, which is rare for a transatlantic trip.

itineraries.route: Bermuda, New England and Atlantic Canada
highlights: Seven sailings, five of them to Bermuda
Three Bermuda sailings add an extra day in port
Most October sailings are Halloween on the High Seas
itineraries.take: Disney's first New York season since 2023. Fall foliage, Bermuda beaches and Halloween at sea make this a fantastic pick for families in the Northeast.

highlights: A 7-night Southern Caribbean sailing on November 5
A 4-night sailing from San Juan to Port Canaveral on November 12, stopping at Lookout Cay and Castaway Cay
itineraries.take: Southern Caribbean islands on the Wish are a rare combination, so this short window is worth a look.

highlights: Castaway Cay and Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point
Very Merrytime holiday sailings in November and December
itineraries.take: Back to the classic short Bahamian trips, now with holiday sailings. Easy to fit around a Walt Disney World visit.

name: Disney Treasure
summary: The Wish's sister ship, themed around adventure and exploration.
kids: It's a Small World Nursery (6 months to 3 years)
guests: about 2,500 at two per room, up to about 4,000
overview: Disney Treasure is the Wish's sister ship, themed to adventure and exploration. It sails week-long Caribbean trips from Port Canaveral, which makes it the pick for families who want a full week at sea.
adults: Palo Steakhouse and Enchanté, adults-only dining (extra cost)
The Rose, an adults-only lounge inspired by Beauty and the Beast
Scat Cat Lounge, an adults-only piano bar inspired by The Aristocats
Haunted Mansion Parlor, Skipper Society (Jungle Cruise) and Periscope Pub (20,000 Leagues Under the Sea)
Senses Spa
pools: The AquaMouse is back with a new show, "Curse of the Golden Egg." There are family pools, splash areas for little ones, and an adults-only pool.
pros: Plaza de Coco, a Coco-themed dining show
cons: Mostly 7-night sailings, so it's a bigger time commitment
It's a big ship, so plan where you're going
tips: If a week feels long, look for the 6-night Bahamian sailing with two days at Castaway Cay.
Book Palo Steakhouse or Enchanté for a sea day.

highlights: Castaway Cay on most sailings
itineraries.take: A full week means more ports and more sea days to enjoy everything the ship offers. A great pick for a first big family cruise.

highlights: Two stops at Castaway Cay
itineraries.take: Two days at Disney's island on one trip is beach heaven, and a little shorter than a full week.

highlights: One longer Eastern Caribbean sailing
itineraries.take: One extra night means one extra island, and more time to enjoy the ship.

name: Disney Destiny
summary: Disney's heroes-and-villains ship and the third in the Wish class, launched in late 2025.
rotation: Pride Lands: Feast of The Lion King
kids: It's a Small World Nursery (6 months to 3 years)
guests: about 2,500 at two per room, up to about 4,000
homePorts: Fort Lauderdale, then Port Canaveral from November 2027
overview: Disney Destiny is the third Wish-class ship, themed to Disney heroes and villains. It debuted in November 2025 from Fort Lauderdale, and it moves to Port Canaveral in November 2027 for its first regular season there.
adults: Palo Steakhouse and Enchanté, adults-only dining (extra cost)
The Rose, an adults-only lounge inspired by Beauty and the Beast
Saga, a Black Panther-inspired family lounge by day that turns adults-only at night
Quiet Cove adults-only pool, with Cove Café & Bar
Senses Spa
pools: The AquaMouse is a two-level water coaster with a new show for this ship, "Sing a Silly Song," alongside "Curse of the Golden Egg." Little ones have the Toy Story Splash Zone, and adults get the Quiet Cove pool. There are about 10 pools and water-play areas across the ship.
pros: Pride Lands: Feast of The Lion King dining
cons: It's a big ship, so plan where you're going
tips: Book Pride Lands early if your kids love The Lion King.
Its November 2027 move to Port Canaveral makes it easy to pair with Walt Disney World.

itineraries.length: 3 to 5 nights, plus a few 7-night sailings
itineraries.route: The Bahamas and the Eastern and Western Caribbean
highlights: Castaway Cay, with some sailings visiting Lookout Cay too
Four 7-night Caribbean sailings in summer 2027
Halloween on the High Seas runs on select ships from September
itineraries.take: A brand-new ship on short trips is a great combination: you get the newest Disney theming without a week-long commitment.

highlights: The Destiny's first regular season from Port Canaveral
Very Merrytime holiday sailings in November and December
itineraries.take: Close to Orlando and a full range of trip lengths, so it's easy to build a parks-plus-cruise vacation.

name: Disney Adventure
summary: Disney's largest ship, built for 3- and 4-night sailings from Singapore.
water: Woody and Jessie's Wild Slides, plus the Ironcycle Test Run roller coaster
rotation: Hollywood Spotlight Club or The Navigator's Club
kids: It's a Small World Nursery (6 months to 3 years)
guests: about 4,200 at two per room, up to about 6,700
overview: Disney Adventure is Disney's biggest ship by far, and the first based in Asia. It sails short trips from Singapore and is built like a floating theme park, with seven themed areas, including Marvel Landing, Toy Story Place, San Fransokyo Street and Wayfinder Bay.
adults: Palo Trattoria, adults-only Italian dining (extra cost)
Mike & Sulley's: Flavors of Asia, extra-cost dining (not adults-only)
Bars and lounges including Tiana's Bayou Lounge, Spellbound and Buccaneer Bar
A spa with a rainforest area, plus an Aladdin-inspired concierge lounge
pools: Toy Story Place has Woody and Jessie's Wild Slides, and Marvel Landing has the Ironcycle Test Run, Disney's first roller coaster at sea, plus Pym Quantum Racers and Groot Galaxy Spin.
shows: The Lion King: Celebration in the Sky fireworks
pros: Disney's first roller coaster at sea
Short trips that are easy to add to an Asia vacation
cons: Mostly sea days, with Langkawi on select sailings
tips: Look for the 4-night sailings that stop in Langkawi, Malaysia, between December 31, 2026 and May 2027.
Plan your Marvel Landing time early in the trip.

itineraries.route: Sea days, with Langkawi on select sailings
highlights: Select 4-night sailings visit Langkawi, Malaysia, the ship's first port of call
itineraries.take: Langkawi adds a gorgeous island stop to a ship that's already a destination in itself. A great reason to plan a trip to Southeast Asia.

highlights: New itineraries from September to December 2027
itineraries.take: Short and packed with things to do, so it's easy to pair with a few days exploring Singapore.

name: Disney Believe
summary: Disney's next ship and the last of the Wish class, sailing from Fort Lauderdale from December 18, 2027.
rotation: Oaken's Table: A Frozen Family Feast
overview: Disney Believe is the fourth and final Wish-class ship. It begins sailing from Fort Lauderdale on December 18, 2027, with 4- and 5-night trips to the Bahamas and the Western Caribbean. Highlights announced so far include the first stage version of Encanto, a Moana-inspired Grand Hall, Oaken's Table (a Frozen dining show), the Sea Notes piano bar and Gazelle, a two-story Zootopia lounge. We'll fill in the rest as Disney shares it.

highlights: Maiden voyage on December 18, 2027
Bookings opened October 19, 2026
itineraries.take: A brand-new ship on short trips, so it's an easy way to try the newest thing at sea. Maiden season sailings book up fast, so compare fares with an older ship too.

adults: Sea Notes, a Little Mermaid piano bar with a live pianist
Gazelle, a two-story Zootopia lounge with family fun by day and adults-only entertainment at night
More adults-only spaces still to be announced
pros: The first-ever stage version of Encanto
Short 4- and 5-night trips from Fort Lauderdale
cons: Maiden season sailings are in high demand
New ships sometimes adjust things in their first few months
tips: Compare a maiden-season fare with the same length trip on the Disney Wish or Destiny before you book.
Fort Lauderdale is about a three-and-a-half-hour drive from Orlando, so plan transfers if you're pairing it with Walt Disney World.
